Name: Heirloom Tools - Your Tools Remember Your Farm Life
Author: YGSnaffy
Description:
[size=5][b]Heirloom Tools[/b][/size]
[i]Your tools remember your whole farm life.[/i]

Every tool and weapon quietly keeps a lifetime record of how you used it. Hover over it and you'll see something like this:

[quote][b]Grandpa's Iridium Hoe[/b]
Tilled 18,402 tiles
Dug up 211 artifact spots
Found a Dinosaur Egg on Fall 12, Y2
With you since Spring 1, Y1[/quote]
Stardew is already about memories. Heirloom Tools makes the hoe you've carried for five years feel like [i]yours[/i].

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Lifetime stats for every tool and weapon.[/b] Tiles tilled and watered, rocks broken, geodes turned up, trees felled, stumps cleared, fish caught, perfect catches, treasure chests, your biggest catch, monsters slain (and which one you've slain most), grass cut, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Moments with dates.[/b] Prismatic Shards, Dinosaur Eggs, Strange Dolls, Golden Masks, Pearls and other rare finds; each tool's first artifact and first fish; legendary fish; milestones like the 10,000th tilled tile; and every upgrade at Clint's. The tooltip shows the latest three. Hold [b]Left Shift[/b] to see them all.[/*]
[*][b]Name your tools.[/b] Press [b]N[/b] while holding a tool (or hovering over one in your inventory) to name it. [i]Grandpa's Iridium Hoe[/i], [i]Old Faithful[/i], [i]Sir Slime-a-lot[/i]: the name shows everywhere the game shows the tool's name.[/*]
[*][b]Milestone messages.[/b] [i]"Your Iridium Pickaxe just broke its 50,000th rock!"[/i][/*]
[*][b]The record travels with the tool.[/b] It's saved on the tool itself, so it survives chests, Clint's upgrades and trades with other players.[/*]
[*][b]Existing saves welcome.[/b] The first time you load a save, every tool you own is marked "Remembered since" that day. Your best tool of each kind gets the farm's lifetime totals from the game's own stats, so your old pickaxe can show off its rock count right away.[/*]
[*][b]Made for sharing.[/b] Screenshot the tooltip, or type [b]heirloom_show[/b] in the SMAPI console to get your whole toolbox as text.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]What each tool remembers[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Hoe:[/b] tiles tilled, artifact spots dug[/*]
[*][b]Watering can:[/b] tiles watered, refills[/*]
[*][b]Pickaxe:[/b] rocks broken, geodes turned up[/*]
[*][b]Axe:[/b] trees felled, stumps cleared[/*]
[*][b]Fishing rod:[/b] fish caught, perfect catches, treasure chests, trash, biggest catch[/*]
[*][b]Swords, daggers, clubs, slingshots:[/b] monsters slain, most-slain monster, weeds cleared[/*]
[*][b]Scythe:[/b] grass cut, weeds cleared[/*]
[*][b]Pan, milk pail, shears, Return Scepter:[/b] times used[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Optional: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in-game.[/*]
[/list]Safe to add to or remove from a save at any time. If you remove it, the records stay hidden in your tools' save data and come back when you reinstall.

[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]N[/b]: name the tool you're holding or hovering over (enter its usual name to remove a name)[/*]
[*][b]Left Shift[/b] (hold while hovering): show all of a tool's moments[/*]
[/list]Both can be changed in config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Single player, multiplayer and split-screen. Each player's tools count only their own work.[/*]
[*]Only uses Harmony postfixes, so it plays nicely with other mods. Tools from other mods are tracked if they're built on the vanilla tool types.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Console commands[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]heirloom_show[/b]: print the record of every tool in your inventory[/*]
[*][b]heirloom_name [name][/b]: name the tool you're holding (no name clears it)[/*]
[*][b]heirloom_reset[/b]: erase the record of the tool you're holding[/*]
[/list]
Source code (MIT): [url=https://github.com/La2o/StardewValley-HeirloomTools]github.com/La2o/StardewValley-HeirloomTools[/url]
